name: Global Energy Obfuscation via Vector Dot Products
description: Replaces the pairwise inequality constraint (graph coloring) with a global sum of vector dot products. The chosen 3D vectors have a dot product of -3 if different and 6 if identical. The target sum of -3m is achievable if and only if all linked pairs have different modes. This prevents models from recognizing the graph coloring structure, thereby disabling their use of crucial graph-specific optimization heuristics like MRV and degree ordering, causing their generic backtracking solvers to TLE on n=40.
